title: Senior Transport Operations Officer (Dispatch/Fleet Management/Transport Operations)
description:
Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours:  ~30 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately 30 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Card Applications



Driver Management

• Driver Timesheet Approval

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
About the Role



We at JVDB Studios are looking for a detail-oriented Accounting Assistant to support bookkeeping and payment processing operations across the business. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing payments, reconciling accounts, and supporting overall accounting operations in a fast-paced remote environment.



The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, proactive, and capable of handling financial processes with a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.



What You’ll Do



You will maintain accurate bookkeeping records using Xero and manage day-to-day accounting and payment workflows. Your responsibilities will include processing accounts payable and payment runs through Wise, reconciling bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms, and ensuring invoices and supporting documentation are properly organized and maintained.



You will monitor accounts payable aging to ensure timely payments to vendors and contractors while assisting with month-end closing activities and financial reporting. Part of your role will also involve coordinating with internal teams regarding expenses, payment requests, and financial documentation.



You will help strengthen financial controls, improve bookkeeping efficiency, and identify opportunities to improve internal accounting and payment processes.



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone with a solid understanding of accounts payable and general accounting processes, along with experience handling bookkeeping responsibilities. Knowledge of accrual accounting principles is important, as well as proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.



Experience using Xero is strongly preferred. Familiarity with multi-currency transactions and payment platforms such as Wise is also an advantage. You should be comfortable preparing and reviewing financial information accurately while maintaining strong attention to detail.



Candidate Profile



This role requires someone who is highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong communication skills and a collaborative attitude are important, along with the ability to manage deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively.



You should have a problem-solving mindset, strong integrity, and the ability to handle confidential financial information professionally.



Why This Role Matters



As transaction volume continues to grow, this role is essential in supporting bookkeeping and payment operations while improving efficiency and maintaining strong financial controls. The Accounting Assistant will play a key role in ensuring smooth vendor and contractor payment workflows and maintaining timely and accurate financial records.



Engagement Details



This is a freelance contractor role with a fixed schedule of Monday to Friday from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM Manila Time. The role is fully remote.



How to Apply



Send your updated resume and any relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience to:







Subject line: JVDB ACCOUNTING ASSISTANT

title: Motion Graphics and Video Editor for Top Podcast Agency
description:
Are you a Cebu-based motion graphics designer and video editor with an eye for creativity and design?



Do you enjoy podcasts, YouTube, and dream of working with top-level shows?



Longwave is a UK-based podcast production agency on the lookout for an exceptional creative to join our growing Cebu team. You'd be working alongside our Filipino editors already on the team, all based in Cebu.

We're seeking a creative individual who can contribute their unique flair and design aesthetic across both motion graphics AND video editing, straddling the two confidently.



Important: this role is for Cebu-based candidates only. Our team is based in Cebu and we want our next hire to be part of that local community.



WHO WE ARE

At Longwave, we're privileged to work with some of the world's most renowned podcasts (you will know them). We are one of the UK's leading video podcast agencies, producing YouTube videos, podcasts, and shortform content for top shows globally. Our Cebu team is an essential part of how we deliver. We work closely, grow people up, and take pride in the quality of what goes out.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Help create YouTube videos, storytelling intros, and shortform content

Collaborate on podcast and YouTube video editing assignments for some of the top shows globally

Help design identities for podcasts and other creators

Actively shape the visual identity of our clients' brands

Deliver exceptional results within tight deadlines, with a supportive team behind you every step of the way



OUR TIERED GROWTH SYSTEM

We run a clear 5-tier progression so you always know what "getting better" looks like and what it unlocks. Each tier comes with a pay bump, with reviews — no favouritism, no guesswork.

Tier 1 — Short Form / Basic Video Editing: Cuts short-form clips and handles basic video edits to brief.

Tier 2 — Basic Motion Graphics: Applies and adapts existing motion templates; handles simple animation work.

Tier 3 — Motion Graphics: Full motion graphics capability, builds custom motion work and new templates.

Tier 4 — Storytelling: Crafts storytelling intros and narrative edits; moves beyond execution into creative direction.

Tier 5 — Elite Storytelling / Unassisted Motion Graphics: Top-level creative with full autonomy. Delivers high-end storytelling pieces and complex motion graphics independently.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Based in Cebu (this is a firm requirement)

1+ years video editing experience

Proficiency in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and the entire Adobe Creative Suite

A genuine interest in video podcasts and a willingness to share and discuss ideas with the team

Good written English for briefs, Slack, and 
 comments

Reliable internet and a machine that can handle 4K footage

Available full time, Monday–Friday, with overlap with UK hours



Qualifications aren't our focus — we're more interested in your skills and what you can bring to the table.



WHAT WE OFFER

An opportunity to learn and grow in a supportive environment

Involvement in diverse projects that challenge and inspire

A chance to contribute your voice and vision to the world of podcasting

A clear 5-tier growth path, not a ceiling



WORK SETUP

37.5 hours/week, full time

Remote (work from home — must be based in Cebu)

Some overlap with UK hours required — exact schedule discussed in interview



COMPENSATION

Starting salary: £2.50 (200php) per hour to £8 (650php) per hour



HOW TO APPLY

Send us 3 videos you've worked on that best represent your current skills. For each one, give us a single sentence on why you chose it. That's it — 3 videos, 3 sentences. We want to see how you think about your own work.



If you have a wider portfolio or a video CV, feel free to send that as well.



In your message, also tell us:

Why this role fits you and which tier you think you'd start at (be honest — we test fairly and place accurately).

A podcast or YouTube show you love and why.



Put the word CEBU-BASED at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.

Please note: if you can't follow these simple instructions, we won't be considering your application. The whole point is showing us you can read a brief and follow it.



We're excited to hear from you and explore how you can help shape the future of podcasting with us.

title: Digital Operations Specialist
description:
About the role

CMW is a UK-based B2B company with a small, close-knit Philippines team. This hire joins that team on the same direct-contract arrangement as our existing PH colleagues — not an agency placement, not a freelance gig.



You will be the person who solves the back-end "how do I make this platform actually do X" problems. Website fixes, HubSpot troubleshooting, OrderWise queries, SharePoint and Teams admin, data work, AI rollout support. Not a developer building from scratch — a digital problem-solver who knows enough across the stack to fix what we break and improve what we have.



This is a full-time, culture-immersed position working UK business hours. We are not looking for someone to deliver tickets. We want someone who owns the problem.



Must-have skills — in priority order



1. Documentation discipline

Writes things down without being asked. Produces SOPs, internal wikis, process notes — for the next person, not just to get the job done. This is the most important signal on your CV.

2. Platform troubleshooting — HubSpot/Salesforce, ERP, Microsoft 365

Has configured and maintained business platforms end-to-end, not just used them. HubSpot or Salesforce admin; OrderWise, SAP, NetSuite, or similar ERP; SharePoint, Teams, or Microsoft 365 admin.

3. SQL — querying, joins, building reports

Can pull data from a database directly using code. MySQL, Postgres, or similar. Power Query and advanced Excel are an acceptable substitute if everything else is strong.

4. HTML and CSS — editing and building pages

Can edit website code directly, not just through a visual builder. WordPress or Shopify template editing counts as a partial substitute if the candidate clearly goes beyond drag-and-drop.

5. AI tooling fluency

Already uses ChatGPT or Claude as an actual working tool — with specific examples of what they've done with it. Not a buzzword on the CV.



Nice to have:



SEO experience — Google Search Console, Ahrefs, on-page optimisation

JavaScript or Python scripting

Power Automate or Zapier — building automations to remove repetitive admin



The attitude we're hiring for:

Skills get you on the list. Attitude is what gets you the role. We have a strong internal reference for the kind of person we want — someone who documents their own work without being asked, asks why before how, and behaves like an employee who owns the problem rather than a freelancer closing a ticket.

- Documents without being asked

- Asks why before how

- Owns the gap between what they know and what they need to know

- Resists hacky shortcuts under time pressure

- Immerses in company culture — not just delivers tasks

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and crosses boundaries voluntarily



This role is not for you if…

- Your background is Fiverr, Upwork, or freelance-only — we want full-time, culture-immersed

- You job-hop every 6 months across agencies — we need someone who stays and learns the business

- You list 30+ tools but can't tell a specific story about any of them

- You prefer working independently with zero oversight — we're a team, not a ticket queue

- You have no documentation examples — if you can't show what you've written down, this isn't the right fit



Ready to apply?

Send your CV and one specific example of something you documented or fixed that others relied on.

title: Senior Video Editor + AI Video Specialist for Fast Growing DTC Wellness Brand (Full Time Potential)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a fast scaling DTC wellness brand selling globally across the UK, EU, Australia, Singapore, and Ireland. We are scaling hard on Meta and Google Ads and need a creative powerhouse who can keep up with our pace. This is not a regular editor job. This is for someone who lives and breathes paid social creative and wants to build something long term with a brand that is on a rocket trajectory.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a video editor who can take a rough concept and turn it into a scroll stopping ad within 24 hours. Speed, craft, and obsession with paid creative are non negotiable. If you are someone who watches Meta ad libraries for fun and gets excited by a fresh AI tool drop, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Editing UGC ads for Meta and TikTok

Producing VSLs (long form video sales letters)

Creating your own high quality B roll from scratch using AI tools, stock footage, and creative sourcing

Cutting cinematic B roll and product driven content

3D animation and motion graphics

AI video generation using Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Sora, Veo, and whatever new tool drops next week

Producing static ads when needed

Iterating fast on winning concepts so we can scale them across countries



MUST HAVE SKILLS



Expert in Premiere Pro and After Effects (DaVinci Resolve a plus)

Strong 3D animation skills (Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar)

AI video tools mastery, especially Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Sora

Ability to generate your own B roll without needing us to provide it, using AI tools, stock libraries, or self shot content

Deep understanding of hooks and why the first 3 seconds make or break an ad

Mastery of subtitle pacing, font choice, placement, and how captions drive retention on Meta and TikTok

Strong music taste and the ability to pick tracks that match the emotion, energy, and audience of each ad (not just grabbing whatever is trending)

Deep understanding of direct response video for paid social

UGC editing that feels native, not over produced

VSL structure knowledge (hook, problem, mechanism, solution, proof, offer, CTA)

Sound design, music selection, color grading

Comfortable working in 
 or similar review tools



BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE



Experience editing for DTC wellness, beauty, or supplement brands

Knowledge of the Meta ads landscape and what is winning right now

Static design skills (Photoshop, Figma)

ElevenLabs or AI voiceover experience

Portfolio that includes work that has actually run as paid ads



YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON IF



You can deliver a finished ad within 24 hours of receiving the brief and assets

You can create your own B roll when we do not have footage to give you

You understand that the hook is the most important part of the ad and you obsess over making it work

You know how to pick music that fits the mood and audience instead of defaulting to generic templates

You treat subtitles as a creative tool, not an afterthought

You are obsessed with your craft and constantly learning new tools

You take feedback well and iterate without ego

You have strong written English and can communicate clearly on Slack

You want to grow with a brand long term, not just bounce between gigs

You have a portfolio that proves you can actually do this work



COMMITMENT



Starting part time with a clear path to full time within 30 to 60 days if the work is fire. We are building a long term creative team and want someone who is in it for the long haul. If you crush this, this becomes your main role.



HOW TO APPLY



To prove you actually read this post and can follow instructions, your application must include all 5 of the following:



1. Your portfolio link with at least 3 examples that match what we need (UGC ads, VSLs, AI video work)

2. One specific example where you used AI video tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, or similar) and a short note on how you made it, especially if you created the B roll yourself

3. Your fastest realistic turnaround on a 30 second ad given full footage and a brief

4. Start your application with the word PATCHWORK so we know you read the entire post

5. Two to three sentences on why you want to work with a wellness brand specifically



Applications missing any of the 5 items will be ignored. We are hiring the right person, not the loudest one.

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

It started with a storm. After a hurricane devastated communities across Puerto Rico, a small team of volunteers showed up with tools, food, and a simple belief: people deserve to be helped. Three years later, that belief has become 200+ missions, 1435+ roofs repaired, 33 farms supported, 1,100 people fed - and a verified world record of 1.1 million acts of kindness in a single week.



Now the movement is going global. Our Pay It Forward campaign is scaling to 200 countries with a goal of 1 billion acts of kindness. We are a local Puerto Rico and federally certified 501(c)(3) non-profit, and we operate the same way we always have - lean, mission-first, and built on people who actually care.

If you want a role where your work shows up in someone's life, not just a dashboard, this might be your place.

You are the glue between our systems and our people.



We have a fully built tech infrastructure: Notion, Airtable, Slack, OneDrive, and Claude AI. Our systems developer has designed and documented the full setup and is creating SOPs and training videos. But he's a builder, not a manager. 



That's where you come in.



Your job is to make sure people actually use the system. You help onboard new team members. You follow up when tasks go quiet. You answer questions when someone gets stuck. You are the human layer between a smart system and a growing global team of volunteers.



The system is the engine. You make sure everyone knows how to drive it - and that no one stalls out.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Onboarding and Training

- Onboard new regional managers, country directors, and core team volunteers into the tech stack (Notion, Airtable, Slack)

Systems Support

-Use Claude AI to support documentation, queries, and process improvements



Communication

-Attend brief weekly check-ins with leadership

WHO YOU ARE



Must-haves:

- Solid experience with Notion and Airtable

- Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar)

- Must have Project Management experience

- Must have reliable internet connection

- Experience with volunteer-driven or non-profit organizations is a plus

- Experience in Lovable and Wordpress website updating is a plus



Personality fit:

- Patient and people-oriented - you're working with volunteers, not employees. They need clarity and encouragement, not pressure.

- Communicative - you surface problems early instead of waiting for them to grow

- Mission-driven - you understand that behind every task is a real person who needed help

- Calm under ambiguity - things are still being built, and you're okay with that

title: Grant Writer
description:
Parity is seeking a full-time Grant Writer Virtual Assistant to lead the company's grant writing, grant reporting, contract management, and impact measurement efforts.



Reports To: Parity Homes CEO and SOS Fund Executive Director

Works Closely With: Parity CEO, Parity Board President and Board Treasurer, SOS Fund Executive Director, third party accounting and bookkeeping firm (hereafter referred to as Key Leadership)



About The Role



As the Grant Writer, you will be responsible for overseeing grant reporting and compliance, from Parity and the SOS Fund’s variety of funding sources including philanthropic foundations, corporate foundations, private donors, government funding including federal, state, and city, and construction debt. You will also be responsible for grant writing using pre-canned templates for future funding opportunities, and for nurturing new relationships with donors. You will support the CEO and Board Treasurer in the management the operating budgets and actuals of the overall Parity Homes program, Parity Builders program, and SOS Fund program, which currently consists mostly of payroll and salaries. Finally, with the support of the CEO, you will liaise with our third-party bookkeeping and accounting firms to ensure proper on-time accounts payable, and appropriate categorization of all transactions for the relevant job (vacant property renovation), class (grant source), and account (type of expense).



Fund Development

o Conduct research on upcoming grant opportunities

o Develop and implement a comprehensive written annual resource development plan with strategies for donors and prospects

o Research and nurture donor prospects and maintain a donor prospect list

o Oversee the build out of a donor database on Salesforce and execute prompt acknowledgement of donations

o Develop and submit grant applications using pre-canned templates

o Serve as liaison between granting entity/agency and Key Leadership

o Participate in staff meetings and development activities as directed

o Performs other duties as directed by the CEO



Contracts and Compliance

o Oversee all government and foundation grants and contracts, ensure programs are in alignment with budget throughout the grant/fund period, and serve as the internal expert on grant compliance

o Work with Key Leadership to develop and implement a documented system of financial controls and accounting policies and procedures to ensure grant compliance and minimize risk

o Write and update standard operating procedures as required, to ensure compliance with government and foundation grants

o Identify potential areas of compliance risk factors and propose risk mitigation techniques

o Provide compliance update reports to Key Leadership as directed or requested



Budgets and Reporting

o Monitor expenditures against budget for the purpose of ensuring the accuracy of reported information, availability of funds, variances, and compliance with established financial guidelines and program policies, practices, and regulatory requirements

o Oversee the production of periodic financial reports on Parity programs

o Liaise with third-party bookkeeping firm to ensure proper on-time accounts payable, payroll, appropriate transaction categorization, and monthly close out

o Assist with external financial audit by preparing documents and serving as liaison for Key Leadership

o Recommend benchmarks that will be used to measure the company’s performance



Requirements

o 2-3 years grant writing experience

o Excellent English writing and speaking proficiency

o Experience with federal fund reporting compliance

o Excellent attention to detail and contract management skills to meet reporting deadlines

o Capable of professionally managing confidential information and applying discretion

o Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to understand the impact of operations on our financial results

o Strong comfortability with Excel

o Comfortability with Microsoft Word and Outlook

o Interested in or have experience working in a start-up environment

o Strategic thinker that can maneuver between high-level goals and very specific tasks to execute those goals

o Self-starter, comfortable with working autonomously, and able to hold yourself to self-appointed deliverables

title: Head of E-commerce & Operations – High Fashion Brand (Shopify + ERP + AI Creative) Full-Time
description:
## About the Role

We are a rising high-fashion label with a strong luxury DNA (Ibiza & Palma). We are looking for a driven, creative and ambitious young professional to take full ownership of our e-commerce universe.



This is a true high-fashion role: you will shape the digital presence of a luxury brand, create editorial-level visuals, build exclusive concierge networks and drive growth with precision and style. Not a freelance gig, not a side job — this is your chance to become the central force behind a fashion brand on the rise.



## Key Requirements (Mandatory)

- Full-time dedication (8 hours per day) with real passion for high fashion  

- No other jobs, freelance clients or parallel activities — we want your full creative energy  

- Direct reporting to the founders  

- Immediate real-time responsiveness during working hours  

- Occasional weekend availability when campaigns or drops demand it  



As the brand grows, you will build and lead your own team of creatives and operators.



## Core Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify Management & Luxury Sales Optimization

- End-to-end Shopify management (online + POS)  

- Create high-end product pages with luxury copywriting and visual storytelling  

- Merchandising, upsell/cross-sell and conversion optimization at the highest level  



### 2. High-Fashion Campaigns & Growth

- Build and execute campaigns for Ibiza, Palma and our exclusive concierge channels  

- Design dedicated landing pages that feel like editorial fashion stories  



### 3. Concierge Network Development (Key Luxury Channel)

- Identify and onboard top concierges in hotels, yachts, private clubs and VIP services  

- Create personalized luxury landing pages and tracking systems  

- Grow this high-touch revenue channel within the most exclusive circles  



### 4. AI-Driven Content Creation & Editorial Visuals

- Generate stunning high-fashion lookbooks and model visuals with AI  

- Create packshots, short-form video content and luxury mood imagery  

- Edit with Canva / Photoshop and add sophisticated fashion-tone overlays  



### 5. ERP & Shopify Synchronization (Critical)

- Daily stock control and instant resolution of discrepancies  

- Seamless flow: 3PL ? Ibiza ? Palma stores  



### 6. Operations, Logistics & Customer Experience

- Daily order flow, shipping and returns with brand-aligned luxury service  



### 7. Performance & Reporting

- Weekly high-level sales & channel reports  

- Data-driven action plans to elevate the brand  



## Who We Are Looking For – Strong Young Women with Fashion Culture

- You live and breathe high fashion and luxury culture  

- Proven Shopify expertise + solid ERP experience (mandatory)  

- Sharp operational mind combined with strong creative and commercial flair  

- Fast, precise and highly responsive — you get things done beautifully  

- You have an eye for aesthetics and understand what makes a fashion brand desirable  



## Required Tools

- Shopify (expert level)  

- ERP systems  

- Canva / Photoshop  

- AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, etc.)  

- Landing page builders (Pagefly, Zeno or similar)  



## What We Do NOT Accept

- Freelancers with multiple clients  

- Candidates with other jobs or side activities  

- Slow or unresponsive profiles  

- Pure technicians without fashion feeling  



## Compensation

Competitive full-time base salary + **generous commission** on e-commerce sales and concierge network performance.  

Top performers have the real potential to earn **a lot** — your income grows directly with the brand’s success and has no upper limit!



## Application Process

Only candidates who complete the mandatory test will be considered:

1. Product page creation (high-fashion style)  

2. AI-generated luxury lookbook visual  

3. Campaign landing page structure  

4. ERP discrepancy scenario  



If you are a strong, ambitious young woman with a deep love for fashion culture and you want to build something iconic while earning very well — this is your role.

title: PR PITCH WRITER (HARO, Qwoted, Featured, SOS)
description:
Web Moves is a boutique digital marketing agency with decades of service specializing in inbound marketing and SEO.



We are looking to hire a highly skilled Digital PR writer who can write organic, informative, and thoughtful copy with a short turnaround time for any of the following topics on a long-term basis:



-Real estate and property management

-Precious metals, gems, and jewelry

-Business management, administration, leadership, and marketing

-Promotional products, events, and brand activation

-Home maintenance, pest control, insects/bugs, and extermination

-Home entertainment, audio/video, home theatre, film, music

-Health, medicine, pain management, wellness, pharmacology, and similar

-Other topics (please mention specialized backgrounds, experience, qualification you may have in other fields)



Pay and Benefits: Payment is either hourly or by piece/word count, please share your preference(s) and what you’re open to. We’re looking for someone who can work around 20 hours per week, and the base hourly rate is $6. Stronger candidates may be offered more. After a successful first year of consistent positive performance, you will be provided a 13th month Holiday Bonus which will be an average of all your months’ total pays.





Please read through areas A through and, in your application, include answers and confirmation for each area.



A) Confirm you meet these Requirements/Focus Areas:



1. Strong English at native written level or higher. Writer should be able to adjust written style between various formalities, tones, and for different audiences.

2. Zero use or dependency with AI. We provide clients with an AI-free experience and therefore cannot compensate any writer for any AI-generated content, text, or phrase. We use a proprietary AI-detection protocol that all submitted work is subject to. If you dislike what AI is doing to our industry, you’ll likely be a good fit for this role!

3. Ability to write under time constraints. Many of our PR opportunities have fast and hard deadlines.

4. Reliable communication. Writers have to coordinate and keep in touch with the team. A lack of communication on a daily basis would not be a good fit for this role.



B) Confirm you can meet this Role Schedule: Write daily online Monday-Thursday with at least one hour available from 9am-5pm Eastern Time for team check-in and communication. Fridays are optional and other work hours are flexible per your preference/needs.



C) Confirm acceptance of these Performance Benchmarks:

1. Weekly written volume (words, memos written, etc)

2. Placement rate (how much of your work results in a placement for a client)

3. Communication regularity and promptness

4. Writing speed (how responsive are you once opportunities are live)



D) State PR platforms you’re familiar with and how much experience you have (if any): ?Examples: HARO, Qwoted, SOS, Featured, Connectively, Source Bottle, etc



E) Summarize your philosophy as you approach this kind of work (which standards are most important to uphold, what makes you happy/unhappy in a job like this, what kind of volume/output/team environment do you thrive in, where do you see the future of this work going?)



F) Confirm you are willing to abide by a strict No-AI policy for all submitted copy and that you are willing to do your best to help us ensure our output is as organic and AI-proof as possible. Our entire team’s success, at every level, depends on integrity and transparency in order to survive.

title: Video Editor + Graphic Designer — Podcast Content, Per-Episode Ongoing
description:
About the role

I produce content for an established, internationally recognised business podcast. I need one reliable person to take over a fixed, repeatable set of episode deliverables on an ongoing per-episode basis. Roughly 4 to 8 episodes per month, every month, paid per episode. This is not a 40-hour seat — it's steady, predictable, ongoing piece work that continues indefinitely for the right person.

What you produce per episode (same six assets every time, from supplied footage and a guest image):



Episode thumbnail — from a locked brand template (you swap the guest photo, set the headline, apply the highlight style)

Episode graphic — template-based

Short looping GIF from the footage

Teaser video, vertical, ~1 minute

Short clip 1, ~1 minute

Short clip 2, ~1 minute



You'll be given the brand templates, fonts, and export specs. You execute an existing brand system accurately — you are not redesigning the look. Speed and consistency matter more than effects.

Required skills (both needed):



Graphic design: clean, pixel-accurate execution within a supplied template. Strong typography sense. You follow a locked layout exactly, you don't reinterpret it.

Video editing: short-form vertical and standard cuts from podcast footage, captions, punchy pacing.

Reliable internet and fast, consistent turnaround.



Tools: Tell me what you use. Graphics templates will be supplied in Adobe and/or Figma so you don't need any specific paid software. For video, use whatever you're strongest in (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, etc.) — I care about output quality and reliability, not the software.



What matters most:



Reliability above all. Every episode has a deadline. The reason this role exists is that I need production I can depend on, every time.

Exact brand consistency. No drift between episodes.

Communication. A message when you start an episode and when it's delivered. Flag problems early.

Self-sufficient. Once you know the system, run an episode end to end without hand-holding.



Arrangement:



Paid per episode, not hourly. $25–$35 USD per episode depending on experience; lower end during a paid trial, reviewed after the first month.



No fixed hours. You manage your time; you hit each episode's deadline.

Ongoing and stable. I pay reliably and on schedule and have contractors I've worked with for years.



To apply (missing any of these = not considered):



Start your reply with the word BANKING so I know you read this fully.

Portfolio showing both short-form podcast video editing and thumbnail/graphic design.

One YouTube-style thumbnail you've made (photo + bold headline style).

One vertical short-form clip you've edited (link).

What software you use for graphics and for video.

One or two sentences on your internet reliability and typical turnaround for a ~1-minute clip.



Paid test: shortlisted applicants are paid to produce one full episode's asset set from real files. No free work.

title: Funnelish funnel builder
description:
We are looking for a new tea
mber to join our fast-growing 6-figure eCommerce business.



We run multiple online stores across Europe and are scaling quickly. Because of this, we are expanding our team.



We are looking for someone to take ownership of one of the most important parts of our business:



Building high-converting sales funnels.



This is NOT a simple copy-paste role.



We are looking for someone who understands copywriting and can improve existing funnels strategically, not someone who blindly copies competitor funnels without understanding why they work.



You must be able to think critically, identify weak points in a funnel, improve messaging and increase conversion potential.



You will receive competitor funnels, templates, and product research as a starting point.



Your role is to take these funnels and turn them into cleaner, stronger, more polished, high-converting versions that are ready to launch and scale.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



This includes:



* Product naming

* Logo creation and branding

* Improving and refining copywriting

* Creating images that strengthen the funnel

* Delivering polished funnels optimized for conversions



We care heavily about quality, creativity, speed, and attention to detail.



Meeting deadlines is extremely important.



4R MODEL - FUNNEL BUILDER



ROLE



* Use competitor funnels as inspiration, not something to blindly duplicate

* Improve structure, flow, branding, messaging, and visuals

* Understand WHY certain funnels convert and improve weak areas

* Create polished funnels that are ready to test and scale



Your work directly impacts the performance and growth of the business.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Analyze competitor funnels and identify what makes them work

* Adapt and improve copy to fit our structure and standards

* Create supporting visuals 

* Work independently and solve problems proactively

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Track working hours using our time tracking tool



RESULTS



* Funnels that meet our KPIs and quality standards

* Clear and persuasive messaging

* Reliable and consistent delivery

* Smooth collaboration with the team



REQUIREMENTS



* Experience with Funnelish

* Strong understanding of direct-response marketing and conversion psychology

* Ability to improve and refine existing funnels strategically

* Basic graphic design skills (logo creation, image editing, branding)

* Ability to improve existing content instead of blindly copying it

* Perfect in English

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Organized, reliable, and deadline-driven

* Strong communication skills



IMPORTANT



When applying, please include:



* Your resume

* Examples of WINNING funnels you personally worked on



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time position

* Excellent hourly pay

* KPI-based bonus system

* Accurate payment through time tracking

* Long-term role with growth opportunities

* Clear SOPs, templates, and competitor examples

* Fast-paced environment with strong learning opportunities



READY TO GROW WITH US?



If building high-converting funnels excites you and you enjoy improving and optimizing existing ideas into stronger converting versions, we would love to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Video Editor (Remote)
description:
JJW Studio is looking for a highly organised and creatively driven video editor to join our growing team on a part-time freelance basis.



We create story-led video content for brands across fashion, jewellery, lifestyle, health and wellness, and corporate industries. Our work ranges from fast-paced social reels to polished brand films and campaign content.



We’re looking for someone who not only knows how to edit, but also understands pacing, storytelling, good taste, and how to create content that actually connects with people.



This is a fully remote role (we are based in Sydney), starting at approximately 16 hours per week, with flexibility across working hours. Availability Monday to Friday during Sydney business hours is ideal for collaboration and feedback.



/ What You’ll Be Working On



* Social-first video content and reels

* Brand and campaign content

* Explainer and corporate videos

* Fashion, beauty, jewellery, lifestyle, and wellness content

* Multi-platform edits for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube



Initially, the role will focus more heavily on social content before expanding into larger campaign and brand film projects over time.



/ What We’re Looking For



You are:

* Fast, organised, and detail-oriented

* A strong communicator who collaborates well remotely

* Proactive and able to start projects quickly

* Calm under pressure and reliable with deadlines

* Someone with a strong eye for aesthetics, pacing, sound, and storytelling

* Comfortable following systems and workflows that keep projects smooth and stress-free

* Passionate about social content, but understand that the story always comes first



/ Required Skills



* Strong experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro

* Understanding of social video pacing and platform formats

* Basic colour grading and sound design skills

* Strong file management and project organisation habits

* Experience using 
, Dropbox, and project management tools

* Basic After Effects skills for transitions, text animation, and motion graphics

* Agency or fast-paced content experience is highly regarded



Experience with CapCut is also helpful for fast-turnaround content.



/ Why Join JJW Studio?



At JJW Studio, we care deeply about the quality of our work and the experience of creating it.



We’ve built systems and workflows that create a calm, collaborative editing environment both internally and for clients. We value good communication, high creative standards, and thoughtful storytelling over trend-chasing content.



You’ll work directly with founder and director Josef, with opportunities for mentorship, creative collaboration, and growth across a wide variety of projects and industries.



For your application submission, please start by using "Brilliant Diamond " in the subject line.



/ What We’re NOT Looking For



* Poor communication

* Sloppy project organisation

* Unreliable turnaround times

* Ego-driven collaboration

* Editors who rely purely on trends without understanding storytelling fundamentals



Role Details

* Remote freelance contract role

* Approximately 20 hours per week

* Monthly payment structure

* Editing days scheduled in advance

* This role will commence as part-time as you edit content for the agency, and then progress to full-time where you’ll work across our roster of clients



/ How To Apply



Please send through:

* Your portfolio/showreel

* Examples of work across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, wellness, or healthcare content



A short written breakdown of 2–3 projects, including:

* The challenge of the edit

* How you approached solving it

* Any ideas or creative input you contributed



We’re excited to find someone who genuinely cares about the craft of editing and wants to grow alongside a creative studio that values story, detail, and collaboration.

title: Senior Media Buyer, Internal Acquisition (Full-Time, USD $3,500 to $5,500/month)
description:
Quick Facts

- Pay: USD $3,500 to $4,500 per month base, based on track record. Performance bonus on

top, tied to acquisition-cost milestones (top performers earn up to ~$18,000 USD/year in

bonus).

- Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week. Bangkok time zone (PHT works perfectly, you're an hour

behind us, no overlap problems).

- Type: Long-term, direct hire by the company. No agency middleman. Paid via international

transfer.

 Work: 100% remote. Use your own laptop.

- Industry: Performance marketing agency for auto repair shops in Australia, US, Canada.

- Reports to: CEO directly.



About the company

New Limits is a 5-year-old performance marketing agency. We've worked with 100+ auto repair

shops across Australia, the US, and Canada. Our clients see 600 to 800 percent return on their ad

spend. The product works.

We spend $40,000 to $60,000 AUD per month on our own Meta, Google, and YouTube ads to

bring in new auto shop owners as sales calls. Our cost to acquire one new client has trended up

over the last 6 months and we need a senior media buyer in-house, full-time, to bring it back down

and own it from there.

This is NOT a client-facing role. You will never get on a call with one of our auto shop clients.

You own one account, ours.



Your job

- Own all of New Limits' own paid ads end-to-end (Meta, Google search, YouTube)

- Lead creative strategy. Write your own copy and headlines. Brief our in-house video editor on

what to film and how. Direct UGC angles. We don't want a button-pusher, we want someone

who d
 what the ads should say.

- Own a disciplined split-testing program. You set the test roadmap each week. Nobody

hands you a list.

- Close the loop with sales weekly. Sit in on a 30-min sync to learn which leads are actually

closing, then refine your targeting and messaging based on lead quality, not just lead volume.

- Drive our cost to acquire one new client down, and hold it there as we scale spend

- Maintain attribution (Hyros is already set up), audience exclusion lists, and a weekly written

report to the CEO

- Build a "winning creative library" over time so we compound on what works instead of starting

from zero every quarter



Who we want

You must have ALL of these:

- 3+ years buying Meta ads (Google Ads is a plus)

- Personally managed AT LEAST $50,000 per month in spend on one offer

- Worked at a marketing agency, OR worked in-house at a real business at scale. Industry

doesn't matter, B2B / high-ticket / coaching / agency / e-commerce / dropshipping all

count. The craft transfers across verticals.

- Real CPA reduction stories you can show with numbers (before vs after, what you changed)

- Strong written English

- Available full-time, long-term



You are NOT a fit if:

- Your "experience" is only running ads for your own products at low spend

- You can't show real ad accounts or screenshots in your application

- You want to keep your own clients on the side

- You're applying because you "want to learn" media buying. We need someone who already

knows.



Tools you'll use

- Meta Ads Manager

- Google Ads

- YouTube Ads

- Hyros (attribution, already set up)

- Slack (team chat)

- Google Sheets (reporting)



How to apply

Send a Loom video (under 5 minutes), either:

- Through the OnlineJobs.ph application form (preferred), or

- Directly to 
 with the subject line: Senior Media Buyer

Application, [Your Name].



In your Loom, answer:

1. Show me one ad account you ran. Tell me the offer, the monthly spend, the starting CPA, the

ending CPA, and what you specifically changed to bring it down.

2. Show me the one ad creative you're most proud of. Tell me why it worked.

3. If I gave you a $25,000 per month Meta budget for an auto shop agency offer where CPA had

been creeping up for 6 months, what would you test first? Be specific.



Also include in the
:

- Your LinkedIn URL (or a written CV if you don't use LinkedIn)

- Your expected monthly salary in USD

- Your earliest start date

- A 1-sentence answer: "Why are you applying for this role?"



We respond to every application within 5 business days. Looms get watched. We will not ask you

to do free spec work in the screening process. If we ask you to build a media plan as part of the

final round, that round is paid.

title: Finance & Operations Assistant Reformly (E-Commerce & Mobile App)
description:
About Reformly

Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community.



Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are a young, ambitious team, and we are looking for an A-player to help us scale our operations and optimize our profitability.





The Role: Mission

To take full ownership of Reformly’s financial administration and daily logistics, bringing impeccable accuracy, proactive communication, and structured execution to our processes in order to drive operational efficiency and profitability.





Tasks & Responsibilities

As our Finance & Operations Assistant, you will sit at the intersection of numbers and logistics. Your day-to-day will involve:

- Daily P&L Management: Keeping the daily Profit & Loss statements 100% up-to-date and accurate, with zero backlog.



- Invoice & Cost Auditing: Rigorously checking invoices and cost breakdowns to identify and resolve any discrepancies or errors.



- Data Entry & Calculations: Flawlessly inputting financial data and running ad-hoc cost calculations as needed.



- Order Fulfillment: Seamlessly managing daily order processing.



- Inventory Management: Maintaining an accurate, real-time inventory tracking sheet.



- Structured Reporting: Translating raw data into highly readable, organized updates for management.



- Proactive Issue Flagging: Immediately raising a red flag when processes slow down, numbers are off, or margins are at risk, and proactively bringing solutions.





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by results, not just hours worked. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive Profitability: Actively audit cost breakdowns, check invoices for discrepancies, and identify operational efficiencies to help realize a gross margin increase from 70% to 73%.



2. Financial Precision: Maintain a 100?curate, up-to-date Daily P&L and cost calculation spreadsheet, ensuring all data entry is processed flawlessly with zero backlog at the end of each week.



3. Fulfillment & Inventory Mastery: Achieve and maintain an average order-to-delivery time of 12 days or less by taking full ownership of daily fulfillment operations. Guarantee zero stockouts through meticulous inventory tracking.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Ownership & Autonomy: You do not need hand-holding or micro-management. You deeply understand the end goal and independently navigate the path to get there. You take full responsibility for outcomes, both successes and failures.



- High Standards & Attention to Detail: You are a healthy perfectionist. You inherently double-check work before submitting. You do not let small details, incorrect numbers, or minor logistical errors slip through the cracks.



- Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets. You can quickly process financial and operational data, spot trends, calculate costs accurately, and draw logical conclusions without getting overwhelmed.



- Organization & Structured Planning: You plan, organize, and schedule tasks in a highly efficient and productive manner. You bring order to chaos and naturally create systems to keep daily operations running smoothly.



- Proactivity & Problem Solving: You act without being told what to do. You can think critically outside the standard operating procedures (SOPs) when exceptions occur. You bring solutions to the table, not just problems.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not align with these:

- All-In Mentality (Impact Over Hours): We are not here just to collect a paycheck; we are here to achieve ambitious goals. You genuinely believe in what we are building and take deep pride in the results you deliver.



- Extreme Ownership (Radically Reliable): You understand that you are a crucial pillar of the team. When you take on a responsibility, the team can trust blindly that it will be executed flawlessly.



- Radical Candor (Direct & Transparent): No beating around the bush. We value efficient, clear, and straightforward communication. You are open, honest, and not afraid to give or receive direct feedback.



- High Velocity (Move Fast & Adapt): We are a young, fast-moving team. You thrive in a high-paced environment, pivot quickly when needed, and combine a sense of urgency with high execution power.



- Humble & Hungry (Continuous Growth): You bring positive energy. You are highly ambitious but leave your ego at the door. You are fiercely eager to learn, extremely coachable, and constantly looking to level up.





How to Apply

We do not want standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. Why you are a perfect fit for this specific role and our core values.



3. A quick tour of your workspace (show us your desk/setup so we can see where the magic happens).

title: Indesign, Word and PDF Accessible Document Remediation to WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA
description:
Statement of Work (SOW):

Accessible Document Remediation. MS Word, PowerPoint and Adobe InDesign to WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA. (MUST HAVE)



We are seeking an experienced document accessibility remediation specialist or small team to support a confidential client project involving remediation of multiple business and policy documents to meet PDF/UA and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance standards.



The engagement involves reviewing and remediating a collection of existing Microsoft Word and PDF documents to ensure they are accessible for screen reader users and compliant with current digital accessibility standards. Deliverables will include fully accessible tagged PDFs and updated accessible source files/templates where required.



Scope of Work



The project includes:



* Remediation of several medium to high complexity reports and submissions (4) ranging from approximately 7 to 105 pages

* Structural accessibility remediation in Microsoft Word

* PDF tagging and compliance remediation to PDF/UA standards

* Reading order, heading structure, lists, tables, hyperlinks and semantic tagging

* Accessible colour contrast and formatting adjustments where required

* Alt text implementation for supplied imagery and graphics

* Accessibility uplift of an existing brand style guide

* Remediation and redesign of accessible document templates in Microsoft Word

* Quality assurance and validation against WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA requirements



Deliverables



* Final accessible PDFs compliant with PDF/UA and WCAG 2.2 AA

* Updated accessible Microsoft Word source documents/templates

* Documentation of any remediation considerations or limitations identified during the process



Project Requirements



* Strong demonstrated experience in document accessibility remediation

* Experience using tools such as Adobe Acrobat Pro, PAC, CommonLook, axesPDF, Microsoft Word accessibility tools, or equivalent

* Understanding of WCAG 2.2 AA and PDF/UA compliance requirements

* Ability to work carefully with structured corporate and government-style documents

* High attention to detail and strong QA practices



Confidentiality



This project is being delivered under a strict confidential client engagement. Successful applicants will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) prior to receiving source materials or client information. Public disclosure of the client, project content, or deliverables will not be permitted.



Timeline



Estimated project duration is approximately 15 to 20 business days from receipt of all required source files and supporting assets.



Notes



* Supporting content such as approved alt text, optimised graphics, and final source materials will be supplied prior to commencement

* Minor layout or colour adjustments may be required to achieve accessibility compliance

* Website implementation, publishing system integration, or e-signature platform remediation are not included in scope unless separately agreed



Please include:



* Relevant accessibility remediation experience

* Examples of similar PDF/Word remediation projects

* Preferred tools and workflows

* Estimated availability during the next 4 to 6 weeks

title: Senior Medical Biller / Full-Cycle RCM Specialist - eClinicalWorks Required - Pain Management Experience Preferred
description:
SCHEDULE:

Full-time, Monday to Friday, during U.S. Central Time business hours.

This is a live, real-time position. This is not an asynchronous or flexible-hours job.



ABOUT THE CLINIC:

We are a U.S.-based interventional pain management clinic. We are looking for a true Senior Revenue Cycle Management Specialist who can independently manage the full billing cycle from start to finish.



This is not an entry-level medical billing role.

This is not a general virtual assistant role.

This is not a data-entry-only role.

This is not a training position.



We need someone who already understands U.S. provider-side outpatient billing, eClinicalWorks, denial management, A/R, payment posting, payer follow-up, appeals, and claim resolution.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a senior biller who has been properly trained in a real U.S. healthcare billing company, RCM company, BPO, or outpatient provider practice. You should understand the entire revenue cycle, not just one small part of it.



You should be able to look at a denied or unpaid claim and know what to do next without waiting for basic instructions.



MINIMUM REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- 5 to 7 years of verifiable U.S. medical billing experience

- Provider-side outpatient clinic billing experience is required

- Strong hands-on eClinicalWorks experience is required

- Full-cycle RCM experience is required

- Experience with denial management and A/R follow-up is required

- Experience with payment posting, ERA/EOB review, and claim correction is required

- Strong written English is required

- Must be comfortable working U.S. Central Time hours

- Must be comfortable with Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily output reports, and screen-sharing when needed



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

- Pain management billing

- Interventional procedure billing

- Workers’ Compensation billing

- Personal injury / lien / attorney-related billing

- Medicare, Medicare Advantage, commercial insurance, and out-of-network billing

- Prior authorization experience

- Medical coding experience

- CPC or coding certification is a strong plus and may qualify for higher pay



ECLINICALWORKS REQUIREMENT:

Hands-on eClinicalWorks experience is non-negotiable.



Do not apply if you only have basic eCW exposure.



You should be comfortable with eCW billing workflows, including:

- Claim creation and submission

- Claim scrubbing

- Clearinghouse rejections

- Corrected claims

- Claim notes and documentation

- Payment posting

- ERA/EOB posting

- Denial tracking

- A/R follow-up

- Patient balance review

- Insurance balance review

- Attaching or referencing EOB/EOR documentation

- Preventing duplicate posting

- Identifying incorrect adjustments or write-offs

- Following payer-specific claim instructions



FULL-CYCLE RCM DUTIES:

You must be able to independently handle the following:



- Verification of benefits

- Eligibility review

- Prior authorization support

- Medical coding review, highly preferred

- Charge entry

- Claim scrubbing

- Claim submission

- Clearinghouse rejection correction

- Denial management

- Appeals and reconsiderations

- Payment posting from ERA/EOB

- Insurance A/R follow-up

- Patient balance review

- Payer portal follow-up

- Phone follow-up with insurance companies when needed

- Workers’ Compensation claim follow-up, if experienced

- Daily reporting of completed work

- Identifying revenue leakage and bringing it to management’s attention



PAIN MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE IS A MAJOR ADVANTAGE:

Our clinic performs interventional pain procedures. Experience with pain management billing is strongly preferred.



Examples include:

- Medial branch blocks

- Radiofrequency ablation

- Epidural steroid injections

- SI joint injections

- Trigger point injections

- Joint injections

- Fluoroscopic procedures

- Infusion-related billing

- Pain-related ICD-10 coding

- Procedure authorization requirements

- Modifier use for laterality and multiple levels



WORKERS’ COMPENSATION EXPERIENCE IS A MAJOR ADVANTAGE:

If you have Workers’ Compensation billing experience, please explain it clearly in your application.



We are especially interested in candidates who understand:

- Claim numbers

- Date of injury

- Adjusters

- Nurse case managers

- EOR/EOB review

- Authorization disputes

- Underpayment follow-up

- Reconsiderations

- Appeals

- Documentation requests

- Payer-specific Workers’ Comp processes



EXCLUSIVITY AND TIME TRACKING:

This position requires full attention during scheduled work hours.



During our scheduled paid hours:

- You may not work for another client

- You may not work for another agency

- You may not work another job

- You may not subcontract your work

- You may not share logins

- You may not use another person to perform your work

- You must be actively working and reachable in real time



Time Doctor will be required.

Screenshots will be reviewed.

Activity levels will be reviewed.

Daily output will be reviewed.

Screen sharing may be required.

Idle time, unexplained low activity, repeated non-work screenshots, or mismatched output will be investigated.



This is a serious position for a serious senior RCM professional.



DAILY OUTPUT EXPECTATIONS:

At the end of each workday, you must send a brief daily report showing what you completed.



Your daily report should include items such as:

- Claims submitted

- Claims corrected

- Clearinghouse rejections worked

- Denials worked

- Appeals or reconsiderations submitted

- Payments posted

- EOBs/ERAs reviewed

- A/R accounts worked

- Payer calls or portal follow-ups completed

- Authorizations checked or followed up

- Issues requiring physician or administrator review

- Bottlenecks preventing claim resolution



DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You have less than 5 years of U.S. medical billing experience

- You do not have hands-on eClinicalWorks experience

- You only know verification of benefits

- You only know data entry

- You only know basic claim submission

- You cannot work denials independently

- You cannot explain A/R follow-up

- You are not comfortable with Time Doctor and screenshots

- You are currently working another full-time job during U.S. Central Time hours

- You are looking for flexible/asynchronous work

- You are an agency or want to subcontract the work

- You are not comfortable being measured by real output



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

A successful candidate will be able to:

- Take ownership of the billing queue

- Identify why claims are unpaid

- Correct rejected claims quickly

- Work denied claims aggressively

- Appeal medical necessity denials

- Post payments accurately

- Avoid incorrect write-offs

- Track payer follow-up

- Escalate real problems clearly

- Improve the clinic’s revenue cycle process

- Communicate clearly with the Practice Administrator and physician



HOW TO APPLY:

Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions exactly.



The very first line of your application message must be:

eClinicalWorks Senior

If this exact phrase is not the first line of your message, your application will be deleted without review.



In your application, answer the following questions:



1. How many years of U.S. provider-side medical billing experience do you have? Please list the specialties you have billed for.



2. Describe your hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks. Do not just say “I know eCW.” Explain exactly what billing tasks you performed inside eCW.



3. Describe your exact process for working a claim denied for medical necessity in eClinicalWorks. Include how you review the denial, documentation, coding, appeal/reconsideration, and follow-up.



4. Explain your experience with payment posting. How do you post an ERA/EOB, identify contractual adjustments, avoid duplicate posting, and d
 whether a balance should remain with insurance or move to the patient?



5. Explain your experience with Workers’ Compensation billing or appeals. Include examples of claim follow-up, EOR/EOB review, adjuster communication, reconsiderations, or underpayment disputes.



6. Describe your experience with pain management, interventional procedures, CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, and prior authorization requirements.



7. Confirm your availability to work full-time during U.S. Central Time business hours. Also confirm that you will not work for any other client, employer, or agency during our scheduled paid hours.



8. Confirm that you are comfortable using Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily reports, and screen sharing.



9. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



10. Why are you the right senior RCM specialist for a pain management clinic that needs someone who can work independently?



SELECTION PROCESS:

Qualified applicants may be asked to complete the following:



- Written screening review

- Live video interview

- Technical eClinicalWorks billing interview

- Screen-share workflow discussion

- Paid practical billing test

- Reference verification

- Trial period before full access is granted



We are looking for a long-term senior RCM specialist who can take ownership of the billing process, not someone who needs to be trained from the ground up.

title: SEO + WordPress Integrator (Junior, Remote, $350 to $550 USD/month)
description:
OVERVIEW

RMD is a digital agency with clients in 20+ countries. We're hiring a Junior SEO + WordPress Integrator to take content briefs from our team and ship them as live, SEO-clean pages.

This is a junior role. We will teach you the advanced parts. What we need from you on day one is solid hands on WordPress (or HTML/CSS), care for detail, and the ability to read a page and notice when something is off.

If you're early in your career and you want to learn SEO properly inside a working agency, this is for you. We don't gatekeep. If you do the work, you grow fast.

Compensation: $350 to $550 USD per month based on experience, paid via PayPal.

Hours: 40 hours per week, Manila time. We need 4 hours of overlap with Morocco/Dubai (so a 1pm to 9pm or 2pm to 10pm Manila shift is ideal).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Take content briefs from our senior writer (blog posts, landing pages, service pages) and build the page in WordPress + Elementor (or hand-coded HTML/CSS, your choice)

Set up the on-page SEO basics on every page you build: meta title, meta description, H1, image alt text, internal links, schema where relevant. Yoast or RankMath

Run weekly site-health checks: broken links, slow pages, missing meta data, indexing issues. Flag what you find

Submit sitemaps, request indexing in Google Search Console, monitor for crawl errors

Help with simple on-page audits: open a page, list what's wrong, suggest fixes

Make small content updates: typo fixes, link swaps, image replacements, schedule blog posts

Read Google Analytics and Google Search Console at a basic level. We'll teach you the rest



WHAT YOU NEED ON DAY ONE

This is a junior role and we will teach you the advanced parts. But you walk in with these or you don't walk in.

Strong WordPress + Elementor. You can build a clean landing page from a brief. You know your way around Elementor templates, global colors, mobile responsive view

OR strong hand-coded HTML/CSS. If you prefer to code pages by hand, we accept that. Show us the work

Basic on-page SEO knowledge. You know what a meta title is, why H1 matters, what alt text is for, how internal links help

Yoast or RankMath setup experience on at least one real WordPress site. Configured the basics: meta title template, sitemap, breadcrumbs, redirects. Not the install-and-leave-default version

Basic image work in Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent. Resize, crop, export at correct dimensions, compress for web (no 5MB hero images)

Hosting + Cloudflare basics. You can log into a cPanel / hosting dashboard, find files, change DNS records, clear a cache. You don't need to be a sysadmin, just not afraid of the back-end

At least one of Ahrefs, Semrush, or Google Search Console used on a real project. Even at a beginner level. You've opened the tool, run a query, and used the output for something real

1+ year of digital agency, freelance, or in-house web/SEO work. Hobby projects don't count. We need someone who has shipped under deadline pressure

You can read a page and spot what's broken or sloppy. Missing alt text, broken links, walls of text with no headings, slow images. You notice

You can read English well. Our briefs are in English. Some clients are French (we translate the brief, you don't need French)

Honesty about what you don't know. "I haven't done schema before, but I can learn" beats "yes I know schema" followed by a mess



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT MOVES YOU UP THE LIST)

1+ live URL you built or wrote that ranks on page 1 of Google for any commercial keyword. Send: URL + target keyword + screenshot from Ahrefs / Semrush / live SERP. This is a strong plus

1 URL where you can show conversion data (CVR%, leads/month, GA4 or GSC screenshot, redacted is fine). Most juniors don't have this; if you do, it puts you ahead

Schema markup deployment (FAQPage, Article, Product) in production

Shopify (we have e-commerce clients)

2+ years of agency or freelance work

French (we have clients in France and North Africa)

Comfortable recording Loom walkthroughs for async comms



WHO WE ARE

A small team distributed across Morocco and Dubai. We work in writing, async-first, and we trust people to ship.

We use AI in the daily work. We expect you to use it too, after onboarding. The test for this role does not allow AI, because we need to see what YOU can do.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT (read this part carefully)

This is a junior seat, not a junior career. Here's what that means:

You will get to do more, fast. Inside 90 days, if you can build clean pages and read a brief, we start handing you content briefs to write yourself, basic keyword research in Ahrefs, and small SEO audit work. Inside 6 months, you can be writing landing pages alongside our senior writer. Inside 12 months, ownership of small clients is on the table.

We teach the advanced parts. Schema, technical SEO, GA4 + GSC diagnostics, Yoast/RankMath setup at a real level, AI-assisted content workflow, internal linking architecture, topic clusters. We don't gatekeep. If you want to learn it, we'll teach it.

We reward progress. Learn a new skill, ship a harder deliverable, hit a result we didn't expect. When that happens, we adjust your pay and scope to match. We don't make people wait 2 years for a real raise. A-players see significant pay growth (50% to 80%+) inside the first year.

The ceiling is what you make of it. We don't have a "you're a junior, stay in your lane" culture. The people who grow inside RMD become senior writers, content leads, and SEO specialists. You d
 how fast.

Who this is NOT for: people who want to stay junior forever and improve very slowly. We hire people who want to move forward. If "comfortable, low-pressure, no growth" is the goal, this isn't the seat. Apply somewhere else, no hard feelings.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply to this post with your CV

Include a portfolio link (Google Drive folder, personal site, GitHub, anything). We need to see at least 2 WordPress pages or HTML pages you built. Screenshots are fine, live URLs are better

Start your
 body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.)

Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences: what's the most recent page you built or content you integrated? What did you do, what tools did you use?

If your application makes our shortlist, we will
 you 3 quick screening questions. Reply to those, and if you pass, we send a free 45-minute practical test. The test is small and clear. You'll see the scoring before you start.

We reply within 5 business days if we want to move you forward. We are a small team and don't have a dedicated recruiter. If you don't hear from us in that window, your application wasn't a fit this round. Don't take it personally and please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that.



WHAT NOT TO SEND

Generic CVs with no portfolio

"I am hardworking and loyal" cover letters with no specifics

Promises you can do everything (we know nobody can)

We're hiring one person for this role. We're patient. We will wait for the right fit.



Apply on OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 with subject "SEO Integrator PH, [Your Full Name]"

title: QA/QC Specialist for Data Annotation
description:
We are looking for a QA/QC Specialist with previous Data Annotation experience to join our team. This role will focus on reviewing annotation work, improving quality, and assisting the Manager in developing better systems, SOPs, QA workflows, and documentation.



The right candidate must be detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in checking annotation outputs for accuracy and consistency.



Responsibilities

-Review completed data annotation tasks for accuracy, completeness, and consistency

-Check labels, classifications, geometry, alignment, and geolocation accuracy

-Identify annotation errors and provide clear feedback to annotators

-Assist the Manager in improving QA systems, SOPs, workflows, checklists, and documentation

-Help monitor team quality performance and recurring errors

-Maintain QA reports, error logs, feedback records, and quality scorecards

-Support training, calibration, and quality alignment sessions

-Help ensure all annotation work follows project guidelines and quality standards

-Recommend process improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and team consistency



Tools and Software Used



The candidate should have experience with, or be willing to learn:



-CVAT for image/video annotation review

-QGIS for geospatial and mapping validation

-Mapbox for map-based review

-Viewfinder for imagery inspection

-Time tracking tools

-Internal SOPs, QA checklists, reporting sheets, and annotation guidelines



Requirements

-Previous experience in Data Annotation QA/QC or annotation review

-Experience using annotation tools such as CVAT, QGIS, Mapbox, Viewfinder, or similar platforms

-Strong attention to detail

-Ability to identify and explain annotation errors clearly

-Good understanding of QA processes, guidelines, and quality standards

-Strong written communication skills

-Organized, reliable, and able to work with minimal supervision

-Comfortable helping improve SOPs, workflows, and QA documentation



Preferred Experience

-Road-related annotation experience, such as road signs, lane markings, road striping, pavement markings, or mapping validation

-Experience working with remote annotation teams

-Experience creating or improving QA checklists, SOPs, training materials, or quality reports

-Experience tracking quality metrics and productivity



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who can do more than just check work. The ideal candidate should be able to help us improve our overall annotation process, support the team, identify recurring issues, and assist management in building a stronger QA/QC system.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



-Your updated resume or CV

-A short summary of your Data Annotation and QA/QC experience

-The annotation or GIS tools you have used before
