title: Implementation Specialist
description:
About YourEra AI Agency

YourEra is a native AI agency. We run complete AI transformation projects for service-based businesses doing $4M to $40M in revenue — Claude Skills, 
 workflows, custom GPTs, autonomous agents, full automation stacks. We don't sell theory. We build.



The founder, Nick Hughes, has delivered 30+ multi-million-dollar digital transformation projects at one of the largest software companies in the world. His expertise is consulting and client relationships — he's business-first, not a deep technical operator. He knows how to scope a transformation, sell it in, manage stakeholders, and ship outcomes that move the P&L. That's why clients hire YourEra.



You'll work directly with Nick. He brings the strategy, the client, and the scoped use case. You bring the build.



About the Role

-We've just signed a 12-month contract with a new client — a property valuation firm operating across Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane with around 20 staff and a roadmap of 24 AI use cases to deploy over the next year. The work spans Claude Skills for desktop and long-form valuation reports, 
 automations between 
, Xero, SharePoint and Outlook, an internal sales-evidence database, an AI quote bot, a marketing engine spanning Google Ads, SEO, and AI-SEO (LLM citation optimisation), and more.



We need a Deployment Specialist to be Nick's right hand on the build — turning scoped use cases into shipped, tested, working automations.



You don't need to know 
 or Claude on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can learn them quickly, and then learn the next tool just as fast. We'll train you.

This is a full-time role: 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Roughly 6 hours per day on client builds, and 2 hours per day on structured upskilling — courses, certifications, building practice projects in Claude and 
. We invest in you growing as fast as the agency does.



What you'll do



- Build Claude Skills from scoped requirements — instructions, SOPs, prompt logic, do-NOT-use clauses, test sets

- Build 
 scenarios end-to-end — webhooks, routers, error handlers, data stores — connecting 
, Xero, SharePoint, Outlook/M365, and the Claude API

- Configure Claude Connectors for clients — Gmail, Google Drive, Monday, SharePoint, Teams, and custom MCP servers where needed

- Write CLAUDE.md files, system prompts, and prompt libraries in the client's voice

- Run Google Ads work — campaign builds, keyword research, ad copy, landing page briefs, performance reporting

- Run SEO work — technical audits, on-page optimisation, content briefs, internal linking, programmatic page builds

- Run AI-SEO work — optimising client content to be cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews

- Test, QA and iterate every build before it goes to the client — log what breaks, fix it

- Document every build — a clear SOP the client's team can follow, in plain English

- Sit on client tuning calls with Nick, take notes, turn feedback into the next iteration the same week

- Maintain the build tracker across all 24 use cases — what's scoped, in build, in QA, live

- Handover and train — walk client staff through each build at go-live



What we're looking for



- Honesty and integrity, above everything else. When you say you'll do something, you do it. When you don't know something, you say so. When you miss a deadline, you tell us before we have to ask. This is non-negotiable — every other skill on this list is teachable, this one isn't.



- A fast learner — you don't need 
, Claude, Google Ads, or SEO experience on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up a new tool over a weekend and be useful with it on Monday



- Technically curious — you like figuring out how things work, you read documentation without being asked, and you're not afraid of an API



- Logical, structured thinker — you can take a process, break it into steps, and spot where it'll break before it does

Comfortable with the common SaaS stack — 
, Xero, SharePoint/M365, Outlook, Google Workspace, Notion



- Excellent written English — most communication is async, in writing, and the client reads everything

Detail obsessed — you test before you ship, you check the output, you find the bug before the client does



- Self-managing — you can take a scoped use case and run with it. You ask the right questions and don't wait to be told what to do



- Available during AEST business hours for at least 4 hours of overlap each day (Philippines timezone is workable)

Bonus: prior exposure to no-code automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable), prompt engineering, Google Ads, SEO, scripting (JavaScript, Python), or working with AI tools day-to-day



Nice to have



- A portfolio or examples of anything technical you've built or taught yourself — the project matters less than what it says about how you learn

- Front-end skills (HTML/CSS, basic React) for client-facing dashboards

- Experience writing technical documentation for non-technical users



What you'll get



- Full-time, long-term role with the agency

- 2 paid hours per day for structured upskilling — courses, certifications, practice builds

- Direct mentorship from Nick — you'll learn the consulting side, the client side, and the build side of AI transformation

- Variety — 24 use cases, multiple tools, real client work, no two weeks the same

- Salary commensurate with experience, paid in USD, plus performance bonuses on shipped builds





How to apply

- Send a short message (no cover letter please) covering:



- The most complex thing you've ever taught yourself — what it was, how long it took, and what you used to learn it

- A time you missed a commitment and how you handled it

- A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or a Loom walking through anything you've built

- Your hourly or monthly rate expectation in USD

- When you can start

description:

Netflix-style documentaries

Audiobooks with visuals

Calm, immersive storytelling

A full story about one character (fictional but realistic)

Focused on money, power, psychology, and life decisions

NO main character face shown in the video

Maintain consistent tone and atmosphere throughout the video

Reuse and organize footage using a structured visual library

Low-edit, high-retention approach

No flashy effects or over-editing

Simple transitions only (fade / crossfade)

Scene-based editing (not sentence-by-sentence cuts)

Slightly more engaging pacing in first 3–5 minutes

Experience with long-form YouTube or documentary-style content

Strong sense of pacing and storytelling

Ability to maintain viewer attention without fast editing

Organized workflow (can manage footage libraries)

Reliable turnaround time

Experience with ambient or slow-paced editing

You will receive:



Script

Voiceover

Direction



Your job is to:



Build the full video

Create an immersive experience

Maintain consistency and quality

Pay:

Per video (based on length and experience)

Long-term opportunity for consistent editors

2–3 examples of long-form or cinematic content

Your turnaround time for a 45–60 minute video

Tam Ma

title: SENIOR LOAN PROCESSOR — Business Funding / MCA (Full Cycle)
description:
Read This Entire Job Post Before Applying

We're a U.S.-based business funding company that places merchants with banks, MCA lenders, SBA partners, equipment financiers, and revenue-based lenders. We close real deals every week. We don't need someone to "learn the industry" — we need someone who already lives in it.

If you've never personally pulled bank statements apart, calculated NSFs and average daily balances, stipped a file, submitted to Kapitus, OnDeck, Credibly, Idea Financial, Fundbox, Forward Financing, Headway, Lendini, or similar — this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



What You'll Actually Do (Daily)



Pre-underwrite every incoming deal: pull MCAs from bank statements, calculate position counts, true revenue, holdback capacity, debt service, NSFs, negative days, and stacking history

Build clean submission packages (app + 3-6 months bank statements + stips) and submit to the right lenders the first time

Negotiate offers — push back on lenders, get factor rates down, extend terms, raise approval amounts, fight for better commission splits

Manage the deal pipeline in our CRM from submission ? approval ? contract ? funding

Communicate directly with merchants for stips, signatures, voided checks, landlord verifications, ownership docs

Handle declines intelligently — reposition the file, find a lender that fits, don't just give up

Run renewals, refis, and stacked positions where appropriate





Required (Non-Negotiable)



Minimum 2 years processing/underwriting MCA, term loans, LOCs, or revenue-based financing for a U.S. broker shop, ISO, or direct lender

Working relationships (or recent submission experience) with at least 8 MCA lenders by name

Can read a 3-month bank statement spread and tell me the true monthly revenue, NSFs, daily balance, and how many positions are stacked — in under 10 minutes

Fluent written and spoken English (we will test this on the call)

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a working webcam

Can work U.S. CST hours



Strongly Preferred/ Not Required



Experience with iLending, Mantis, OnyxIQ, ZohoCRM, or similar broker/ISO platforms

Prior experience at a U.S. ISO or funder shop (please name them in your application)

Underwriting credentials, finance/accounting background, or formal training





Do Not Apply If



You've only done "lead gen" or "appointment setting" and want to call yourself a processor

You need someone to walk you through what a factor rate, holdback, or specified percentage is

You ghost, disappear, or go silent for days at a time

You're juggling 3 other clients and this will be your side gig

You've never actually submitted a deal to a real lender portal

You inflate your resume — we verify everything, including calling former employers





Compensation Structure

Base Salary (paid weekly or bi-weekly via Wise):



$640 - $1000 USD / month base hourly rate/ depending on experience, region, and references

30-day paid trial period at the lower end of the band — full base kicks in after passing

Reviewed every 90 days based on performance



Performance Bonuses:



3% per funded deal you fully processed (submission to funding)

+$150 bonus on any deal funded over $100K

+5% of net commission on any deal where you found the lender / negotiated terms that beat the initial offer by 10%+

Monthly volume bonus: $300 if you process 15+ funded deals in a calendar month, $750 if you process 25+



Other:



10 paid days off after 90 days

Paid U.S. holidays after 6 months

Annual performance bonus tied to total funded volume

Long-term: opportunity to grow into a Head of Underwriting / Ops role as we scale



Top performers in this role consistently clear $3,500+  in incentive/commissions only plus the base hourly rate. If that doesn't excite you, you're not the person we're looking for.



How to Apply (Follow Exactly — We Auto-Reject Applications That Don't)



1. Subject line - Pineapple Loan Processor

(Yes, "Pineapple." If you skip this word, your application is deleted unread. This is the first filter.)

2. In the body of the application, Create a voice recording and answer these in order:



How many years have you processed MCA / business loan files for U.S. shops? Which companies?



Name 8 MCA or business lenders you've personally submitted deals to in the last 12 months

What's the highest-deal-volume month you've ever personally processed? (# of funded deals + total $ funded)



A merchant has $45K monthly revenue, 6 NSFs in the last 3 months, 2 open positions totaling $850/day in payments, and a 580 FICO. Which 3 lenders do you submit to first, and why?



What's your expected monthly base salary in USD?



Confirm you can work 8 AM – 5 PM CST consistently



3. Attach:

A 60-90 second unedited video (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) introducing yourself, naming the last 3 companies you processed for, and walking us through the toughest deal you ever got funded.



(If you attach a pdf resume, it will not be looked at and you will not be considered for the position.)



4. Include three professional references with phone numbers and
s — preferably former managers at U.S. shops. We call all of them.



Applications without the code word, without the video, or with vague answers will not be reviewed. We're hiring one person. Make it obvious it should be you.

title: Financial Accountant - AU Company
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.



We’re looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to join our high-performing remote team. If you're a proactive finance professional who thrives on ownership, continuous improvement, and meaningful work, we’d love to meet you.



What You’ll Be Doing

As our Financial Accountant, you’ll be a key player in ensuring accurate, insightful, and timely financial reporting. You’ll collaborate across teams, drive process improvement, and uphold the financial integrity of our mission.



Key Responsibilities:

-Own the Month-End Close

Lead all aspects of EOM: journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and financial statement prep.

-Deliver Insightful Reporting

Produce monthly and quarterly management reports, including variance and trend analysis.

-Ensure Regulatory Compliance

Prepare BAS, IAS, and statutory filings, ensuring alignment with AASB and tax standards.

-Champion Continuous Improvement

Streamline workflows, introduce automation, and enhance internal controls.

-Collaborate Cross-Functionally

Partner with Marketing, Operations, and other non-finance teams to align on budget and strategy.

-Support Strategic Projects

Get involved in cost analysis, ERP upgrades, and special projects that shape our financial future.



Why Join Bare?

Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work directly supports families during one of the most vulnerable times of their lives.

Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Australia with the tools and autonomy to succeed.

Mission-Driven Culture: Join a team that leads with empathy and integrity—where your voice matters.

Growth & Innovation: Help shape scalable systems in a business that's growing fast and disrupting the norm.



About You

You’re not just technically sharp, you bring heart and high standards to everything you do. You thrive in fast-paced environments and care about doing work that matters.



Must-Haves:

-Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or similar.

-CPA/CA qualification (or in-progress).

-2–3+ years' experience in financial accounting, ideally in service-led sectors.

-Familiarity with Australian accounting standards, BAS/IAS, and financial reporting.

-Understanding of various accounting standards relevant to Bare and consolidations of many entities.

-Attention to detail and excellent reconciliation skills

-Strong ERP (MYOB, Xero, SAP) and Excel skills.

-Strong Excel/Sheets skills and automation of manual processes in your mindset-DNA



Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience in mission-driven sectors (healthcare, aged care, funeral services).

• Adaptability in high-growth or high-volume environments.

• Resilient, working with little or no supervision.

• Experience of managing international teams, interaction with multi-entity organizations, and experience within companies with a minimum annual revenue of $50 million.

• Handle ambiguity, competing priorities, and strict deadlines. Create and implement scalable processes, including training. Integrate AI and automation.



Core Values We Look For

• Empathy: You care deeply about people—colleagues and customers alike.

• Accountability: You take ownership and deliver results with pride.

• Clarity: You communicate financial information in a clear, human way.

• Curiosity: You’re always looking for a better way and love solving problems.



Perks & Benefits

-Fully remote work setup with flexible hours

-Purpose-driven work with real human impact

-Growth and learning opportunities in a scale-up environment

-Supportive, inclusive team culture



Please include your resume when submitting your application. Thank you!

title: Lifecycle Marketing & Klaviyo Strategist (High-Ticket E-Commerce)
description:
Lifecycle Marketing & Klaviyo Strategist (High-Ticket E-Commerce)

Remote Contract Position



Part-Time to Start | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We’re looking for someone who understands that high-ticket customers do not buy the same way as impulse shoppers.



This is not a “send a few newsletters” role.



This is a deep lifecycle marketing position focused on customer psychology, segmentation, automation strategy, retention, lead nurturing, and revenue growth inside Klaviyo for a fast-growing high-ticket poultry and outdoor lifestyle e-commerce brand.



Our customers often spend weeks researching before purchasing. They compare shipping options, financing, layouts, upgrades, predator protection, flock types, and long-term durability before making a decision.



We need someone who can build systems that guide customers through that journey naturally.



You’ll help architect the full customer lifecycle:



lead capture

nurture sequences

quote follow-up systems

financing psychology flows

segmentation

SMS strategy

post-purchase retention

referral systems

customer education funnels

reactivation campaigns

customer lifetime value growth



This is a strategic role, not a basic
 assistant position.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Lifecycle Strategy & Automation

Build and optimize advanced Klaviyo flows

Create customer journeys based on behavior, products viewed, financing interest, quiz answers, and engagement

Develop nurture sequences for long consideration-cycle customers

Create quote follow-up systems and reactivation campaigns

Build segmented flows for different customer types and buying behaviors

Improve retention and repeat engagement

Customer Psychology & Conversion Optimization

Understand emotional friction points that prevent purchases

Develop flows around:

financing hesitation

shipping anxiety

custom order overwhelm

first-time flock owner education

delivery expectations

seasonal buying behavior

Write messaging that feels human, helpful, and trustworthy — not robotic or spammy

Segmentation & Personalization

Build advanced customer segments

Implement lead scoring logic

Personalize flows based on:

browsing behavior

quote activity

purchase history

coop type interest

flock type

financing engagement

geographic considerations

customer engagement level

Analytics & Optimization

Monitor flow performance and attributed revenue

Run A/B tests

Improve open rates, click rates, and conversion rates

Identify drop-off points in the customer journey

Recommend new revenue opportunities

Report on performance trends and actionable insights

Collaboration

Work directly with ownership

Translate real customer conversations and objections into scalable automation systems

Help shape long-term retention and lifecycle strategy

Required Experience

You MUST Have:

Strong Klaviyo experience

Shopify experience

Advanced segmentation experience

Automation and flow-building experience

 and SMS lifecycle marketing experience

Strong understanding of conversion psychology

Experience with high-ticket e-commerce

Strong written English

Ability to think strategically, not just execute tasks

Strong organizational and analytical skills

Huge Bonus Points If You Have Experience With:

HubSpot

Quiz funnels

Long sales-cycle businesses

Outdoor structures, sheds, cabins, or home improvement industries

Freight or logistics-related businesses

AI-assisted personalization

Retention marketing strategy

Customer lifetime value optimization

UGC/review/referral systems

This Role Is NOT For Someone Who…



We want to be upfront about the level of thinking this role requires.



This is not a basic “send campaigns and build abandoned carts” position.



We are looking for someone who understands:



customer psychology

long buying cycles

lifecycle marketing

segmentation

conversion behavior

and revenue strategy



This role is NOT for someone who:



relies mostly on prebuilt Klaviyo templates

sends generic mass campaigns with little segmentation

focuses more on aesthetics than conversion strategy

only has experience with low-ticket impulse purchases

writes robotic or overly corporate copy

uses heavy discounts as the primary strategy

builds flows once and never optimizes them

needs constant direction for every task

cannot analyze customer behavior or buying friction

has never worked with long consideration-cycle customers

thinks
 marketing ends after checkout

is looking for a passive “set it and forget it” client



We are looking for someone who enjoys:



solving conversion problems

analyzing customer behavior

building smart automation systems

testing and optimizing

improving customer trust and confidence

and finding hidden revenue opportunities



If your experience is mostly:

“welcome flow + abandoned cart + monthly newsletters,”

this role is probably not the right fit.



What Success Looks Like

Increased quote-to-sale conversion

Improved customer engagement

Better lead warming

Higher flow-attributed revenue

Increased financing conversions

Better reactivation performance

Improved retention and repeat engagement

Better customer segmentation and personalization

Lower unsubscribe rates

Stronger customer trust and confidence

Hours & Compensation

Part-time to start (approximately 10–20 hours/week)

Long-term growth opportunity

Flexible remote work

Compensation based on experience and ability level

Performance bonuses may be available for strong results

Additional Application & Screening Process



Because this is a strategic lifecycle marketing role, we use a more in-depth screening process than a typical marketing position.



We are not simply looking for someone who can “send
s.” We are looking for someone who understands customer psychology, segmentation, buying behavior, and revenue strategy.



Initial Application Questions



Please answer the following thoughtfully. We care far more about your thinking process than polished buzzwords.



1. Customer Psychology



Why do you think a customer would request a shipping quote for a premium chicken coop and then stop responding afterward?



2. Strategic Prioritization



If you inherited a Klaviyo account generating little revenue, what are the first 3 things you would audit and why?



3. Lifecycle Strategy



A customer:



viewed premium coops multiple times

visited financing twice

requested a shipping quote

then disappeared after receiving shipping pricing



Walk us through the lifecycle flow you would build for this customer.



4. Segmentation



Give 3 examples of customer segments you would build for a high-ticket coop company and explain why.



Finalist Evaluation Process



Finalists may be asked to complete a paid mini audit of our current lifecycle marketing systems.



This may include:



reviewing flows

identifying customer journey gaps

segmentation opportunities

reactivation opportunities

quote recovery strategy

lifecycle optimization ideas



We are specifically looking for strategic thinkers who can identify revenue opportunities, customer friction points, and automation improvements — not just suggest generic campaigns or templates.



What We Look For In Strong Candidates



Strong candidates naturally think and speak in terms of:



customer behavior

segmentation

friction points

customer confidence

trust-building

buying stages

lifecycle journeys

retention

reactivation

attribution

customer lifetime value



We value strategic thinking far more than flashy design work or generic marketing buzzwords.



To Apply



Please send:



your resume or portfolio

examples of Klaviyo flows or lifecycle systems you’ve built

answers to the questions above

relevant platform experience

and anything else you feel demonstrates strong strategic marketing ability



We are looking for someone who understands customer behavior and lifecycle strategy — not just someone who knows how to send
s.

title: DIRECTOR OF TAX ADVISORY & KNOWLEDGE OPERATIONS
description:
About Us

Turnkey Financial Solutions, Inc. (TFS) is a California-based tax strategy and advisory firm serving high-income W-2 professionals and service-based business owners with major 7- and 8-figure annual revenue. Our clients are concentrated in the San Francisco Bay Area technology sector. A significant proportion of our W-2 client base are first-generation Indian immigrants navigating sophisticated US tax challenges around equity compensation (RSUs, ISOs, NSOs, ESPPs, AMT), charitable planning, real estate, and cross-border family financial planning. We have built a strong reputation in our market 91 five-star reviews and we are now adding a senior credentialed advisor to grow with the firm long-term.



The Role

The Director of Tax Advisory & Knowledge Operations is the firm's senior credentialed advisor. You will work in partnership with the CEO across three integrated functions: (1) leading day-to-day client advisory and prospect-qualifying conversations; (2) driving the firm's knowledge-operations infrastructure — the calculators, content, AI-avatar knowledge base, and supporting tools that scale the firm's advisory output; and (3) serving as the firm's internal technical authority, with backup from outside tax controversy counsel on the most complex strategy questions.



If you are a US-credentialed tax professional who is equally comfortable explaining an ISO disqualifying disposition to a Bay Area engineer on Zoom and managing a content-production project across a distributed team and you want a long-term seat with growth path at a sophisticated small firm this role is for you.



Day-to-Day Responsibilities



1. Client Advisory (primary)

Lead day-to-day client advisory meetings. Prepare planning analyses, equity-compensation deep dives, and year-end tax-strategy meetings. Explain complex tax positions in plain English. Partner with the CEO on the firm's highest-stakes client conversations; carry the day-to-day relationship on the rest.



2. Prospect Qualifying (secondary)

Take inbound prospect interest calls. Qualify on fit (income level, business structure, complexity, geography). Explain TFS's services and book qualified prospects with the CEO for closing. Handle straightforward engagements end-to-end as judgment matures. This is not a cold-sales role; you receive warm inbound leads generated by the firm's marketing pipeline.



3. Knowledge Operations (significant)

Own the firm's strategy-calculator portfolio and content infrastructure. Drive the project-management cycle across the Philippines-based team: Michelle (strategic technician / formulas), Anna (videos), Joice (templates and TaxDome). You break down each new calculator into sub-deliverables, assign work, set due dates, track status, and drive to completion. You are the technical reviewer who certifies output accuracy before it ships. The firm's AI-avatar knowledge base and sales-enablement content sit in your portfolio.



4. Technical Review & Risk Management (with outside counsel backup)

Review aggressive tax strategies the firm considers placing with clients. Identify the issues that require outside counsel — §170(m) qualified intellectual property, §170(e) ordinary income property, disguised sale, economic substance, reportable transaction status, Circular 230 written-advice exposure. Coordinate with the firm's outside tax controversy counsel on the highest-risk matters; serve as the in-house interlocutor who packages questions for counsel and translates responses into firm policy. You are not solo on the most difficult technical calls — counsel is the safety net.



5. Tax-Prep QC and Disclosure Compliance (operational)

Review prepared returns flowing through the ProConnect pipeline before signature, with focus on returns claiming non-routine deductions, complex equity compensation, or aggressive positions. Own Form 8283 substantiation, Form 8275 disclosure decisions, Form 8918 material advisor compliance (where applicable), and the firm's workpaper protocol for strategy-gating documentation.



Required Qualifications

Active US CPA license OR US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential. CPA preferred; EA acceptable for candidates with otherwise exceptional fit.



5 to 10 years of US tax experience, with demonstrated depth in advanced individual taxation for high-income professionals.



Subject-matter competence in: §170 (charitable contributions, including §170(m) and §170(e)), equity-compensation taxation (§83, §83(b), §421-§423, §409A as applied to NSOs, ISO/AMT interaction, ESPP qualifying dispositions), Subchapter K basics for partnership pass-through strategies, real estate tax (§469 passive losses, §1031, cost segregation, STR loophole), §6694 preparer standards, Circular 230 §10.34 and §10.37.



Strong client-facing communication. You can explain an AMT cliff to a non-expert in under five minutes without jargon.



Project-management discipline. You have led at least one end-to-end content or product build with a distributed team, and you can show what shipped.



Reading and writing fluency in US tax law. You can write a one-page client memo on a §83(b) decision and a one-page technical memo for outside counsel, and you know the difference between the two.



Preferred Qualifications

LLM in Taxation, or law degree.

Big 4 captive alumnus (Deloitte USI, EY GDS, KPMG GDC, PwC AC) or comparable US-tax-focused practice.

Prior consulting or advisory-firm experience with consultative client intake or prospect-qualifying responsibilities.

Direct experience with HNW tax planning or M&A tax.

Experience with TaxDome, ProConnect, Holistiplan, Corvee, or similar planning-software stacks.



Compensation and Engagement

Php 80,000 to Pph 110,000 base monthly salary, commensurate with experience, credential profile, and demonstrated breadth across the role's functions.



Discretionary performance bonus in Year 1; formalized incentive structure in Year 2 once mutual fit is established.



Employment via Employer of Record (Deel or equivalent) in your country of residence with full local statutory benefits.



No relocation required. Permanent remote role.



Long-term, career-track role with growth path to firm leadership.



Geography and Time Zone

We are open to candidates based in the Philippines. Each has trade-offs we want you to be aware of before applying. We will calibrate time-zone expectations to your location and to the role's evolving balance between back-office, client-facing, and team-management work.



Philippines-based candidates: our existing tax-preparation, content, and template-production team is Philippines-based, so a Manila-based Director would join a team that already operates with the same time zone, language conventions, and cultural norms a substantial operational advantage for the Knowledge Operations function of the role. Strong English fluency and generally neutral accent. The Philippines US-credentialed pool is real, particularly for US Enrolled Agents and for US CPAs with prior Big 4 outsourcing-center experience. Primary working hours are Manila business hours with approximately 4–6 hours per week of late-evening overlap with US Pacific time for client and prospect calls. Cultural fit with the firm's existing team is, in our experience, exceptional.



Please indicate your location in your application; we will calibrate the time-zone expectation and the specific functional emphasis of the role accordingly.



How to Apply

Submit (a) your resume, (b) your active US CPA license number and issuing state (or EA enrollment number), and (c) a 200-word cover note describing a tax-planning or strategy-review engagement where your work materially changed a client's outcome — what you did, what the client did, and what the financial or compliance result was.



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a 3-hour paid take-home case study before final interviews. The case is a synthetic equipment-leasing strategy review designed to surface candidates who can read aggressive tax positions critically, write a defensible technical memo, and communicate the conclusion in plain English. Candidates who clear the case advance to a 2-round interview with the firm's CEO.

description:
Looking for a data-driven, highly organised virtual assistant to work full-time for an Australian online company in the industry of business coaching for females.

We have a great business culture, a wonderful close-knit team, global reach and expansion, a lot of new skills to teach you (as well as embracing the ones you will bring to us), but we do need you to bring MAGIC to the table for us too.





**** IMPORTANT NOTE: We need someone who is 10000?dicated to this role. Please do not apply if you are planning to work multiple jobs, have a side hustle or anything that will distract you from being available, attentive and able to respond immediately during dedicated work hours. 



You will be assisting one of our Directors in an extremely fast paced and dynamic environment. 





***MUST HAVE QUALITIES (please do not apply if you feel you are not at a highly proficient level in these areas):



- STRONG ATTENTION TO DETAIL AND ACCURACY. If you are prone to typing errors, spelling mistakes and regularly have to fix small errors, this role is not suitable for you.

In this role, you should be FINDING the mistakes and fixing them proactively, WITHOUT having to be asked first.

You will be working for the fastest moving person in the company, scheduling calendars and timetables, liaising with vendors and coordinating appointments/events/engagements/obligations, answering messages and ensure total organisation and control. 





- UNDERSTAND THE IMPORTANCE OF YOUR ROLE IN A MUCH BIGGER SYSTEM. We are looking for someone who wants to join a team and make a difference. Someone who understands that every task given plays a bigger role to the company's success and you are not there to hide in the shadows. We are a family. Loyalty and dedicated will be rewarded. 



- PROFICIENCY IN SYSTEMS. In this role, you will be asked to use systems and workflows for certain tasks and projects, to ensure better efficiency and alignment with the team. Building out SOPs, learning and creating new systems, using new software should all be second nature to you. If you are technologically challenged, or don't enjoy learning new systems, then this role will not be suitable for you.



- CREATIVE EYE FOR BUSINESS DESIGNS. You will be asked to put together well designed documents, spreadsheets, proposals, infographics, presentation slides and PDFs that will be presented onstage, to potential clients and the rest of the team.

Proficiency in CANVA is required, as well as good graphic design skills for BUSINESS. We appreciate creativity, but we also need to make sure your designs are simple, eye catching and gets to the point!



- ORGANISATION AND TIME MANAGEMENT SKILLS. You will be working to assist one of our high-flying directors to ensure their task list is completed in a timely manner. It's extremely important you are used to working in dynamic, fast-paced environments and able to meet urgent deadlines. It's also very important that you know how to run a tight ship, manage a full calendar with no double bookings or overlaps. 



- Highly proactive and efficient in not only completing day to day administrative tasks, but also identifying new tasks that should be completed that will benefit the Director, the company and create better flow and efficiency for the team.



- Strong communication skills, both spoken and written. You will be required to communicate and report to the Director and CFO regularly to ensure the Director's task lists are completed on time and without error. You will also communicate to our clients on behalf of the team and the Director. Proper use of grammar, punctuation and proficiency in English is vital, especially in written format.



- Highly productive with proven results, ability to meet firm deadlines and prioritise tasks accordingly.



- YOU MUST BE ABLE TO WORK AUTONOMOUSLY WITHOUT SUPERVISION. 

You will be supervised and managed, but we do not like to micromanage. We prefer to just trust that you are working to the best of your ability and that assign tasks will be done in a timely manner. We trust that if there are issues or delays, you will proactively advise us first and find solutions, and NOT wait until you are nudged or prompted. 

Trust is earned, not given. We are looking for someone who can do the tasks without being watched 24/7. 



*** SKILLS PREFERRED/REQUIRED (as noted):



- Experience and proficiency in CANVA and design tools (Required)

- Experience with SOCIAL MEDIA updates, video editing, and optimising for platforms such as Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Youtube, Tiktok (Required)

- Experience in Community Management and communication with members and clients (Required)

- Experience with handling budgets, bookkeeping, live event preparation (preferred)

WORKING HOURS:

title: Business Deal Sourcing & Outreach VA
description:
We’re seeking a highly organised, research focused virtual assistant to source acquisition opportunities, contact brokers and maintain an accurate deal pipeline. You will be the first point of contact between me and brokers, so confidence, clarity and discretion are essential.



Key Responsibilities

 - Research: Actively hunt broker sites, marketplaces and directories to find deals that fit our “buy box,” not just random listings.

 - Outreach: Proactively contact brokers to request IMs, follow-up persistently and close the loop.

 - Pipeline: Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM or spreadsheets, with clear status labels and follow-up dates.

 - Screening: Filter out clearly non-viable leads and escalate only those that genuinely warrant the principal’s time.

 - Urgency: Flag urgent or high potential deals with a short, structured summary.



Growth Path (Post Trial)

Once you prove you can consistently source, track, and qualify leads, you’ll move into deal analysis, including:

 - Structuring and summarising IMs in a consistent, investor ready format.

 - Extracting KPIs (e.g., revenue, EBITDA, customer concentration, lease terms) and presenting them clearly.

 - Spotting and highlighting potential risks.

 - Comparing deals against our investment thesis.



Must-Have Qualifications

You are not a passive admin; you are the first point of contact between me and brokers. You must be comfortable initiating contact, following up assertively and protecting my reputation in every interaction.

 - Confident outbound communicator – Comfortable calling senior brokers and following up persistently if
 not working.

 - Proactive problem solver – Owns follow-ups and escalates issues without being told.

 - Strong written English and business tone – Writes concise, professional outreach that sounds like a serious investor’s representative.

 - High impact researcher – Goes beyond the first page results and finds genuinely relevant deals.

 - Extreme attention to detail – Keeps the pipeline clean and accurate.

 - Ownership mindset – Manages the pipeline as if it were their own.

 - Discretion and maturity – Handles confidential deal information professionally.



Preferred Experience

 - Experience in M&A, business brokerage, market research or lead generation.

 - Comfortable reading basic financial statements (revenue, EBITDA and profitability).

 - Hands on experience with CRM or structured spreadsheets.



How to Apply

Send a brief cover letter explaining why you’re a strong fit. Include:

 - Your experience with internet research or lead generation.

 - An example of how you manage complex, ongoing tasks.



Start your application with the word “ACQUISITION” so we know you read the full post.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short, paid 30-minute research task to demonstrate their skills.

Time off respected (1 day per week to rest)

 groups (wedding planning, Mac productivity)

   - Draft a reply, send it to me for approval — I post it from my account

   - You do not pretend to be me or post on my behalf in communities



4. **Light research and admin**

   - Find Mac/productivity blogs that do app comparison pieces (for Caesura outreach)

- Sales calls or outreach requiring native English/Dutch

- Strategy or creative direction

- Comfortable with digital tooling, eg Canva or any agent

- Previous experience submitting to launch directories (Product Hunt, BetaList, etc.)

- Familiarity with the indie/SaaS world

- Basic understanding of how App Store / Play Store listings work

- 2-week paid trial. If it works, we continue indefinitely. If not, we part on good terms.

1. A 3–5 sentence intro — who you are, not your resume

2. One sentence on why this role interests you specifically (skip if generic)

3. One launch directory you'd submit Caesura (Mac break reminder app) to, and why

4. Your hourly rate

5. Any AI generated response will be ignored, if your English is not 100% perfect, that's okay



Skip the templated cover letter. I read every application and a copy-paste pitch tells me you'll copy-paste the work.



Looking forward to hearing from you.



— Thomas

title: Business Analyst & Advice Associate
description:
APPLY ONLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE



Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: $10-$15ph



ABOUTUS

Purpose Advisory started as a financial advice firm. Today, we've grown into something broader.

We now focus on business services and executive assistance, while continuing to support financial advice businesses behind the scenes. Our team works closely with business owners and advisers to keep operations running, clients looked after, and growth moving.

We're a remote team based in Sydney. We work fast, take ownership, and care about doing things properly. If you're someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, takes initiative, and wants real responsibility from day one, we'd like to hear from you.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The three priorities of this role are to:



1. Relationship manager - Own our business client relationships

2. Project Manager - manage project scope and secondment of our team to work with our clients

3. Executive Assistant - Operate as a professional assistant for entrepreneurs



This is not a traditional EA role. We are looking for someone sharp, analytical and commercially minded who can sit at the intersection of business analysis, client coordination and project management.



You will work closely with our founder and senior adviser, Tristan Scifo to prepare business analysis and be a relational point person for business clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Support the adviser with research, business strategy prep and meeting preparation

- Attend and contribute to business client meetings alongside our adviser

- Send professional communications and follow-up
s on behalf of the adviser

- Build and maintain client business plans, financial models, dashboards and reporting tools

- Proactively flag and address client issues

- Assist with the development and installation of AI-based systems for our clients

- Be the primary point of contact for business clients between sessions - tracking projects, scheduling, and keeping everything on track

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in our CRM

- Coordinate skilled staffing delivery across the team — liaising with our marketing, operations and accounts staff to ensure client deliverables are done on time

- Be able to work directly with business clients as highly skilled executive assistant



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1. Strong analytical skills — you are comfortable with financial statements, business metrics, spreadsheets and building models from scratch

2. Commercial mindset — you understand what makes a business work: revenue, margin, cash flow, team, systems

3. Strong AI-skills - “Me plus my AI can solve anything”

4. Executive assistant experience - You’ve worked directly with a CEO or director of a large Australian or US-based company

5. Project management experience — you can run multiple client projects simultaneously without dropping the ball

6. Exceptional written English — your
s and documents are clear, professional and polished

7. Confident communicator — warm and professional with clients, direct and efficient with the team

8. High trust, high discretion — you will handle sensitive financial and business information for real businesses

9. Experience with tools like Xero, Airtable, Google Sheets and Notion is an advantage

10. Exposure to business coaching, financial services, consulting or advisory work is a strong plus

11. Degree in engineering, business, finance, accounting or a related field preferred



WHAT YOU WILL GET

- Full-time remote role with a high-trust Australian firm

- Direct access to and mentorship from an experienced business coach and entrepreneur

- Varied, intellectually stimulating work — no two clients are the same

- A chance to genuinely contribute to the growth and outcomes of real businesses

- A team that invests in its people and treats everyone as a professional
